intro.title: 考研英语二 · 作文模板库
intro.desc: 大作文（图表作文）通用模板。先认占位符，再按「认图 → 数事物 → 挑走势」三步选句：骨架句给结构，弹药句池给变化——不要整段硬套，按提示挑句拼装。
rules: 认图：柱状 bar chart / 饼图 pie chart / 折线 line chart / 表格 table——图表类型决定首句怎么写
数事物：1 个用单句；2 个用对比句（while / By contrast）；3 个以上先分组再写（最大 / 中间两个 / 其余）
挑走势动词：上升 rose / climbed；下降 fell / declined；一升一降才用 By contrast；平稳用 held steady / plateaued
第二段（原因）：骨架句 + 句池挑 1~2 句 ≈ 55~65 词，尽量留一句回扣图表数字
第三段（建议）：正面或负面选一版，骨架句 + 句池挑 1~2 句 ≈ 50~60 词
字数核算：三段合计 150~180 词最稳（考研要求 150+）。宁可少写一句，也不要超
placeholders: 这一题的题相关词（题眼）
图里要对比的第 1/2/3…个事物
数值区间（讲波动幅度时用）
bar chart / pie chart / line chart
中文行里图表类型的泛称
该图表的类型（柱状 / 饼）

chart_guide.title: 图表适配表（2010–2026 英语二大作文，共 17 套真题）
chart_guide.desc: 先认图表：动态图（有时间变化）用动态第一段；静态图（只比占比）用静态第一段。下表不按年份排列，而是按「动态 / 静态 → 走势特征」分组：同一组的年份可直接套同一组功能句，只需换关键词与数据。

decisions.v: 只写两句：一句给数值，一句给走势（From…to…, rose from…to…）。不要硬凑对比句。
用对比结构：同向且速度不同 → While B rose slowly, A climbed sharply；一升一降 → A climbed…, while B fell…，后半句才用 By contrast。
先分组再写：最大项 takes the largest share at…，中间两个 come next at… and…，其余 account for only…。不要平铺五个数字。

decisions.k: 走势 = 都升（速度不同）
decisions.v: 用「② 同向不同速」骨架：Both rose, but A climbed…while B only went…。不要再套 By contrast。
用「③ 一升一降」骨架：A climbed…, while B fell…。三个事物时补一句 By contrast。
用「① 单线上升」骨架两句即可：It rose from…to… without a single fall。不必凑对比句。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第一段（图表描述）
sections.title: 静态图表第一段
sections.subtitle: 适用：饼图 / 柱状图中各类别的占比分布（只比比例，没有时间变化）
sections.en: The {{chart}} chart above clearly illustrates how {{topic}} is distributed. {{item1}} takes the lead, accounting for {{percent1}}, followed by {{item2}} and {{item3}} at {{percent2}} and {{percent3}} respectively, while {{item4}} comes last at {{percent4}}.
sections.cn: 该 {{chart}} 图清晰地展示了 {{topic}} 的分布情况。{{item1}} 遥遥领先，占 {{percent1}}；其后是 {{item2}} 和 {{item3}}，分别占 {{percent2}} 和 {{percent3}}；而 {{item4}} 位居最后，占 {{percent4}}。
sections.note: {{chart}} 处按图型填 pie / bar / line；句池里挑 1~2 句替换骨架后半段，控制字数，不必全写。

sentences.en: Taken together, the three largest items make up {{percent total}}.
sentences.cn: 前三项加起来占 {{percent total}}。

sentences.en: The pattern is clear: a few items dominate the rest.
sentences.cn: 整体格局清晰：少数几项占据了主导地位。

sentences.en: The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.
sentences.cn: 最大项与最小项之间差距很大。

sentences.en: The figure varies sharply from group to group: it stands at {{percent1}} for {{item1}}, but falls to just {{percent3}} for {{item3}}.
sentences.cn: 组与组之间差别悬殊：{{item1}} 高达 {{percent1}}，而 {{item3}} 只有 {{percent3}}。

tips: 静态图只比占比，别写时间——一旦出现年份，就改用动态第一段。
三个以上事物一定要先分组（最大 / 中间 / 其余），不要平铺五个数字。
sections.demo: The pie chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of travel are distributed. Appreciating the scenery takes the lead, accounting for 37%, followed by relieving pressure and other aims at 33% and 15% respectively, while fostering independence comes last at 6%.

sections.group: 大作文 · 第一段（图表描述）
sections.title: 动态图表第一段
sections.subtitle: 适用：折线 / 柱状图中事物随时间变化 —— 先看走势，选下面 3 套骨架之一
sections.en: The {{chart}} chart above clearly illustrates the changes in {{topic}} from {{time1}} to {{time2}}. During this period, {{item1}} rose sharply from {{num1}} to {{num2}}. By contrast, the figure for {{item2}} saw a modest increase, climbing from {{num3}} to {{num4}} over the same period.
sections.cn: 该 {{chart}} 图清晰地展示了 {{time1}} 到 {{time2}} 期间 {{topic}} 的变化。在此期间，{{item1}} 从 {{num1}} 急剧增至 {{num2}}。相比之下，{{item2}} 仅略有增加，从 {{num3}} 攀升至 {{num4}}。
sections.note: 先看走势再选骨架：只有 1 个事物用 ①；都涨但快慢不同用 ②；有涨有跌用 ③。三个事物时，③ 的第 2 句后面接句池里的 By contrast 那句。

sentences.en: The two moved in the same direction, but not at the same pace.
sentences.cn: 两者方向一致，但速度不同。

sentences.en: The gap between the two widened over the period.
sentences.cn: 两者的差距在这一时期拉大了。

sentences.en: The first half of the period saw a steady rise, while the last few years brought a sharp acceleration.
sentences.cn: 前半段稳步上升，最后几年明显加速。

sentences.en: In the later years, {{item1}} climbed sharply while {{item2}} stayed almost flat.
sentences.cn: 后几年 {{item1}} 急剧上升，而 {{item2}} 几乎原地不动。

sentences.en: The two moved in opposite directions.
sentences.cn: 两者朝相反的方向变化。

sentences.en: The figure more than doubled over the period.
sentences.cn: 这一数字在该时期翻了一倍多。

tips: 动态图必须有时间（{{time1}} → {{time2}}）；没有时间就改用静态第一段。
同向但速度不同：② 已经把 while 写进句子里，不必再用 By contrast。

During this period, subscriptions in developing countries rose sharply from 0.5 billion to 4 billion. By contrast, the figure for developed countries saw a modest increase, climbing from 0.7 billion to 1 billion over the same period.

skeletons.label: ③ 一升一降
skeletons.en: The {{chart}} chart above clearly illustrates the sharp contrast in {{topic}} between {{item1}} and {{item2}} from {{time1}} to {{time2}}. During this period, {{item1}} rose sharply from {{num1}} to {{num2}}. By contrast, the figure for {{item2}} saw a steady decline, falling from {{num3}} to {{num4}}.

During this period, Chinese brands rose sharply from 26% to 31%. By contrast, the figure for Japanese brands saw a steady decline, falling from 35% to 26%.

skeletons.en: The {{chart}} chart above clearly illustrates the changes in {{topic}} from {{time1}} to {{time2}}. From {{time1}} to {{time3}}, it rose steadily from {{num1}} to {{num3}}, and then climbed sharply to {{num2}}.

sections.title: 第二段 · 原因（机制句池）
sections.subtitle: 不背整段：1 句引入 + 从下面 40 条机制里挑 3 条（每条都是一个完整原因）
sections.group: 大作文 · 第一段（图表描述）
sections.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sections.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

alts.can be attributed to: is largely attributable to（加长版）/ stems from
alts.a combination of factors: two major factors（写 2 条）/ three major factors（写 3 条）/ several major factors（写 4 条）

linkers.banned: First and foremost / The first one is
linkers.better: Primary among these is ... / The most immediate factor is ... / Chief among them is ...
Equally important, ... / Just as significant, ... / Beyond that, ...
which 从句：..., which has lowered the threshold for ...

framework.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
framework.trans: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。
framework.cn: 通用开头句：不承诺条数，17 年任何图表都成立；想点明条数再换 two / three / several major factors（见下方同义升级，须与正文条数一致）。

framework.en: Primary among these is + 机制句 ①
framework.cn: 第 1 条：高级衔接词开头，接句池里最有力的原因（押题句 / 观念 / 收入…）。
第 2 条：换个衔接词、换个角度；句尾可用 which 从句焊因果（..., which has lowered the threshold for ...）。

framework.en: （可选）A further driver is + 机制句 ③
framework.cn: 第 3 条想写就写（17 年的适配方案全是 3~4 条候选，写 3 条最稳）。

sentences.en: As household incomes have grown, {{topic}} has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity.
sentences.cn: 随着家庭收入提高，{{topic}} 已从奢侈品变成日常必需。

sentences.en: Online platforms and mobile payment have made {{topic}} quicker and easier to arrange.
sentences.cn: 线上平台和移动支付使 {{topic}} 变得更快、更方便。

sentences.en: People now judge {{topic}} by what it does for them rather than by what others think.
sentences.cn: 如今，人们评判 {{topic}} 的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。

sentences.en: The figure for {{item1}} climbed from {{num1}} to {{num2}}, which matches the overall trend.
sentences.cn: {{item1}} 从 {{num1}} 升到 {{num2}}，与整体趋势一致。

sentences.en: Public spending on infrastructure has made {{topic}} far more widely available.
sentences.cn: 基础设施方面的公共支出使 {{topic}} 更加普及。

sentences.en: Cities have absorbed millions of new residents, and demand for {{topic}} has grown with them.
sentences.cn: 随着城市吸纳了大量新居民，{{topic}} 的需求也随之增长。

sentences.en: Sitting all day has turned {{topic}} from a hobby into a practical need.
sentences.cn: 长期久坐使 {{topic}} 从爱好变成了切实的需求。

sentences.en: Longer working hours have made people value the little free time they have.
sentences.cn: 工作时间变长，人们更看重仅有的空闲时间。

sentences.en: Schools now treat {{topic}} as part of the routine rather than an optional extra.
sentences.cn: 学校现在将 {{topic}} 视为常规活动的一部分，而非可选的附加内容。

sentences.en: Old traditions survive only when people find new ways to pass them on.
sentences.cn: 只有当人们找到新的方式来传承旧传统时，它们才能得以延续。

sentences.en: Longer life expectancy has changed how families plan for their later years.
sentences.cn: 寿命的延长改变了家庭对晚年的规划。

sentences.en: Domestic producers have narrowed the quality gap, so buyers no longer pay a premium for foreign brands.
sentences.cn: 国产品牌缩小了质量差距，消费者不再愿意为外国品牌支付溢价。

sentences.en: Young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently.
sentences.cn: 如今的年轻人比父辈换工作频繁得多，「忠诚」的意义也随之改变。

sentences.en: Employers now look for experience as much as for grades.
sentences.cn: 如今用人单位既看重成绩，也看重经验。

sentences.en: Daily life has become more rushed, and {{topic}} is one of the few things people still fit in.
sentences.cn: 生活节奏不断加快，{{topic}} 成了人们为数不多还愿意抽出时间去做的事。

sentences.en: Advances in technology have made {{topic}} part of daily life rather than a privilege.
sentences.cn: 科技的进步让 {{topic}} 从少数人的特权变成日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: AI-powered tutoring gives students instant feedback that a single teacher can hardly provide.
sentences.cn: 人工智能辅导能给学生即时反馈，这是单个老师很难做到的。

sentences.en: Shared online courses have begun to narrow the gap between urban and rural classrooms.
sentences.cn: 共享网课已经开始缩小城乡课堂之间的差距。

sentences.en: Rising environmental awareness has turned {{topic}} into a mark of responsible living.
sentences.cn: 环保意识的提升，使 {{topic}} 成为负责任生活的标志。

sentences.en: Better public transport has made low-carbon travel a practical choice for young people.
sentences.cn: 更完善的公共交通，让低碳出行成为年轻人切实可行的选择。

sentences.en: Short videos and self-media have opened a far easier route into {{topic}} for young people.
sentences.cn: 短视频和自媒体，为年轻人了解 {{topic}} 打开了一条便捷得多的路径。

sentences.en: Some providers put immediate profit first, which leaves quality and safety poorly managed.
sentences.cn: 一些商家把眼前利润放在首位，导致质量与安全疏于管理。

sentences.en: Rules have not kept pace with how quickly {{topic}} has spread.
sentences.cn: 规则的更新速度，赶不上 {{topic}} 扩散的速度。

sentences.en: Technology has steadily lowered the cost of what once required far more time and money.
sentences.cn: 技术不断降低那些过去需要更多时间和金钱才能获得的东西的成本。

sentences.en: Suppliers have noticed the demand and moved quickly to meet it.
sentences.cn: 供给方察觉到了需求，并迅速作出回应。

sentences.en: Different groups have piled their needs on top of one another, and supply has struggled to keep pace.
sentences.cn: 不同群体的需求层层叠加，供给已经难以跟上。

sentences.en: Not only has this shift changed how people spend their time, but it has also reshaped what they expect from daily life.
sentences.cn: 这一变化不仅改变了人们支配时间的方式，也重塑了他们对日常生活的期待。

sentences.en: We cannot ignore the fact that it also brings problems that were less visible before.
sentences.cn: 我们不能忽视，它同时也带来了此前不那么明显的问题。

sentences.en: Without proper guidance, people may follow the trend without understanding its costs.
sentences.cn: 若缺乏恰当引导，人们可能盲目跟风，却不了解其中的代价。

sentences.en: Fiercer competition has made {{topic}} a way for people to keep their edge.
sentences.cn: 竞争加剧，使 {{topic}} 成为人们保持优势的一种方式。

sentences.en: Seeing friends and colleagues take up {{topic}} makes others far more willing to follow.
sentences.cn: 看到朋友和同事开始 {{topic}}，其他人也更愿意跟随。

sentences.en: Supportive policies have removed much of the risk from choosing {{topic}}.
sentences.cn: 支持性政策消除了选择 {{topic}} 的大部分风险。

sentences.en: Information about {{topic}} now spreads faster than anyone can verify it.
sentences.cn: 关于 {{topic}} 的信息传播速度，已经快过任何人核实的速度。

sentences.en: Growing concern about health has turned {{topic}} into a routine rather than an occasional choice.
sentences.cn: 健康意识的增强，使 {{topic}} 从偶尔的选择变成日常习惯。

sentences.en: Smaller households have changed what families expect from {{topic}}.
sentences.cn: 家庭规模变小，改变了家庭对 {{topic}} 的期待。

sentences.en: Longer years in education have raised demand for {{topic}}.
sentences.cn: 受教育年限延长，推高了对 {{topic}} 的需求。

sentences.en: Careful marketing has made {{topic}} look like a natural part of modern life.
sentences.cn: 精心设计的营销，使 {{topic}} 看起来像现代生活理所当然的一部分。

sentences.en: Consumers often cannot tell good {{topic}} from bad until it is too late.
sentences.cn: 消费者往往直到为时已晚，才分得清 {{topic}} 的好坏。

sentences.en: The fear of missing out pushes people into {{topic}} before they have thought it through.
sentences.cn: 害怕错过的焦虑，促使人们还没想清楚就投入 {{topic}}。

sentences.en: Short-term thinking leads people to ignore what {{topic}} costs in the long run.
sentences.cn: 短期思维让人们忽视 {{topic}} 长期要付出的代价。

tips: 万能开头：a combination of factors 不承诺条数，什么年份都成立；想点明条数再换 two / three / several major factors（必须与正文条数一致）。第 1 条用「Primary among these is ...」，第 2 条换「Equally important, ...」——高级衔接词见下方 ✎ 行，同篇不重样，别用 First and foremost。
引入句 10 词 + 机制句挑 3 条 ≈ 55~62 词。
每条机制句自带 {{槽位}}，改成这道题的具体对象即可；不要 40 条都写。
挑法：先看图表属于「钱变多 / 技术变便宜 / 人变忙 / 政策投入 / 观念变了」哪两类，再各挑一条。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第三段（总结建议）
sections.title: 第三段 · 立场 + 对策（三套骨架选一）
sections.subtitle: 正面 / 负面 / 中性三套骨架并列，下面一份句池三套通用
sections.en: On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
sections.cn: 总的来说，这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分的理由相信，这一趋势将在未来几年继续发展。
en_struct: every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead
phrases: more than one side has to act
has a different job to do
is not limited to those who can pay
不只属于付得起钱的人
tips: 三套骨架按题目极性选一套，不要混用：趋势向好选①，问题要治选②，说不清好坏（双面 / 现状分布）选③。
骨架只给首尾两句，中间对策从句池挑 1~2 句，拼起来 55~70 词。
同一条 tag 在正/负两版里是两种语气（如「个人」正面写「选适合自己的」、负面写「管好自己的习惯」），按骨架极性挑。

sentences.en: What matters most is whether families and schools treat {{topic}} as a normal part of life.
sentences.cn: 最关键的是，家庭和学校能否把 {{topic}} 当作日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Government can fund public facilities so that {{topic}} is not limited to those who can pay.
sentences.cn: 政府可以为公共设施提供资金，使 {{topic}} 不再局限于那些有支付能力的人。

sentences.en: Schools can build {{topic}} into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.
sentences.cn: 学校可以把 {{topic}} 融入日常安排，而非当作额外的任务。

sentences.en: Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told.
sentences.cn: 家庭的作用最为关键：孩子模仿的是大人的行动，而非说教。

sentences.en: Companies can make {{topic}} cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people.
sentences.cn: 企业可以让 {{topic}} 更低价、更便捷，从而让更多人能够使用。

sentences.en: Media should report on {{topic}} honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks.
sentences.cn: 媒体应如实报道 {{topic}}，既不夸大好处，也不夸大风险。

sentences.en: Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd.
sentences.cn: 个人应按自身情况选择，而不是随大流。

sentences.en: Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns.
sentences.cn: 明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。

sentences.en: Platforms should design simple, honest services instead of ones that hold users’ attention for as long as possible.
sentences.cn: 平台应设计简单、真诚的服务，而非想方设法让用户长时间停留。

sentences.en: Documentaries and short videos can show how {{topic}} works in real life.
sentences.cn: 纪录片和短视频可以展示 {{topic}} 在现实生活中的运作方式。

sentences.en: Small habits matter: a little {{topic}} every day adds up over a year.
sentences.cn: 小习惯很重要：每天一点 {{topic}}，日积月累一年下来就不一样。

sentences.en: We should bear in mind that what is at stake goes far beyond the figures themselves.

sentences.en: In this way, it can become a lasting source of benefit rather than a passing fashion.
sentences.cn: 这样，它才能成为长久的益处来源，而非一时的风潮。

sentences.cn: 只有个人与机构共同努力，这一潜力才能充分实现。

framework.en: On balance, what the figures reveal is a shift that deserves careful judgment rather than simple praise or blame.
framework.trans: 总的来说，这些数据揭示的是一种变化，它值得审慎判断，而非简单的褒贬。
framework.cn: 立场句：双面题 / 现状分布题用——既不吹好也不唱衰。

framework.en: To make the most of this shift, + 主体句 ①
framework.cn: 主体句：正负两版的句池都能挑，中性题优先挑「观念 / 政府 / 学校 / 个人」这类不带褒贬的。

framework.en: Whether it proves to be a blessing or a burden depends on how well it is managed in the years ahead.
framework.trans: 它究竟成为福祉还是负担，取决于未来能否得到妥善管理。
framework.cn: 收束句：把结论落到「管理」上，避开对趋势本身下判断。

tips: 什么时候用：图表既说不上好也说不上坏——老龄化（寿命延长 + 养老压力）、择业因素、线上/线下占比。
正面版说「值得欢迎」、负面版说「问题严重」都不合适时，换这一版：只描述变化，把结论落到「怎么管」。
主体句直接从下面正负两版的并集里挑，语气中性的（观念 / 政府 / 学校 / 个人）优先。

sentences.cn: 媒体应报道真实风险，而不是把它当成吓人的故事。

sentences.en: Individuals need to watch their own habits instead of assuming they are safe.
sentences.cn: 个人需要留意自己的习惯，而不是想当然认为没问题。

sentences.en: Employers should find out why experienced staff are the least satisfied, not just look at the overall figure.
sentences.cn: 雇主应弄清为什么资深员工最不满意，而不是只看总体数字。

sentences.en: A company that ignores this gap will lose the very people it most depends on.
sentences.cn: 忽视这一差距的公司，会失去它最依赖的那批人。

sentences.en: Classes on {{topic}} can help students tell safe use from misuse.
sentences.cn: 关于 {{topic}} 的课程能帮学生分清正常使用和滥用。

sentences.en: A stable routine at home leaves less room for the problem to grow.
sentences.cn: 家中规律的生活作息，会让问题更难滋生。

sentences.en: Keeping a simple record of daily use is often enough to spot the problem early.
sentences.cn: 简单记录一下每天的使用情况，往往就能及早发现问题。

sentences.en: We should bear in mind that what is at stake goes far beyond the figures themselves.
sentences.cn: 我们应当记住，真正关键的远不止这些数字本身。

sentences.en: In this way, it can become a lasting source of benefit rather than a passing fashion.
sentences.cn: 这样，它才能成为长久的益处来源，而非一时的风潮。

sentences.en: Only through the joint efforts of individuals and institutions can this potential be fully realized.
sentences.cn: 只有个人与机构共同努力，这一潜力才能充分实现。

sentences.en: If these measures are implemented, a balance between development and protection will be within reach.
sentences.cn: 若这些措施得以落实，发展与保护之间的平衡便指日可待。

teacher: 档位的分界线不是语言，是内容针对性
四档（10~12）与五档（13~15）的区别不在句式，而在内容要点是否全部覆盖且贴合这张图。语言再漂亮，只要第二段归因、第三段建议换到任何年份都能原样使用，就会被压在四档——这是模板最大的风险，也是每次写作必须往句子里塞「本题专属信息」的原因。
数据必须准确，这是硬指标
数值、单位、年份、倍数一个都不能错：最高/最低值要有，起止值要对得上图。算错倍数或抄错数字，直接扣内容分，比语法错误严重得多（如 0.5 → 4 billion 是 8 倍，不是"翻了一倍"）。
P1 图表描述 40~55 词 · P2 原因 55~70 词 · P3 评论 45~60 词，合计 150~180 词。超 200 词不加分，只会提高出错率；低于 150 词按字数不足扣分。P2 只挑 3 条机制句，P3 只挑 1~2 句主体句。
万能句只能保底，不能加分
Relevant authorities should…、with the development of…、Only in this way can… 阅卷人一眼能认出。它们保证语言分不掉，但内容分要靠图里的具体信息：最高值是谁、涨了多少、哪一年翻倍、哪个主体在领跑。
评论段要"为什么/怎么办"，不要表态
P3 写「我认为这个现象很好」等于没写。四档以上要求「对目标读者产生预期效果」——先用一句立场句表态，再给出可执行的做法（谁该做什么），最后一句收束。
时态：图用过去，评论用现在
图表数据都是历史年份 → 一般过去时 / 过去完成时（climbed / had doubled by 2008）；归因与建议 → 一般现在时（has become / should provide）。时态混用是最常见的失分点。
题干里 directions 的句子抄进作文不计内容分，还可能被判套作。把 "interpret the chart and give your comments" 这种要求用自己的话转述成句子框架。
分数预期：认真填槽 11~13 分，13+ 靠"本题专属"
数据准确 + 三段完整 + 语言基本准确 = 二档到三档（11~13 / 15）；13 分以上要求每一段都有针对这张图的具体归类或具体主体，这是模板给不了的，只能靠平时套真题练出来。
flow: 圈出四件事：图型（柱 / 饼 / 折线 / 表格）、对象（几个事物、谁和谁比）、时间跨度（哪年到哪年 / 单一时间点）、单位（billion / million / %）。再判断类型：静态（一个时间点的占比分布）还是动态（随年份变化）。
静态 → 用「静态骨架」；动态 → 三套走势骨架里选一套：单线上升（只有一个事物）/ 同向不同速（都在涨但快慢不同）/ 一升一降（有涨有跌）。选错骨架整段都会别扭。
想好 2 个具体机制，不要写「生活水平提高」这种空话。可用的一套推理链：收入↑ → 价格↓ / 可及性↑；技术↑ → 成本↓；政策 + 基建 → 供给↑；观念变 → 需求变。
P1 = 骨架 + 1 句数据补充；P2 = 骨架 + 2 句归因；P3 = 骨架 + 2 句主体句。边写边填 {{ }} 槽位，不要留到最后统一填（容易漏）。
每个 {{ }} 都要换成本题的具体内容，数字与图一致、单位统一。不确定写哪个主体时，回头用「⚡ 弹药句池」按用途标签挑。
对着下方「✅ 交卷前自查表」逐条过；重点看数字、时态、单位、词数四项。
data_lang: climb · rise · grow · increase · surge · soar
climb / rise / grow 是中性动词，surge / soar 表示猛涨。rise 是不及物动词，没有被动：the number rose ✓ / was risen ✗。典型句：It climbed from 0.5 billion in 2000 to 4 billion in 2008.
同样没有被动语态：the figure fell from 0.7 to 0.5。说到"降到"用 drop to，"下降了 X"用 fall by X（to 是终点、by 是幅度，别混）。
副词修饰动词：rose steadily / fell sharply。说倍数最划算：more than doubled（翻了一倍多）/ nearly tripled / three times as many as。
account for · make up · take up · constitute · the largest share
标准说法：{{item1}} alone accounts for {{percent1}} of the total.注意 account for 用主动，占比的主语是事物本身。percentage 指数值本身（a high percentage），percent 跟在数字后（20 percent，不加 s）。
three times as many as · twice the figure for · outnumber … by 2 to 1 · slightly higher than
两组对比的万能骨架：A rose from X to Y, while B fell from P to Q.幅度不同时：Both rose, but A climbed faster than B.
peak at · hit a low of · level off · remain steady · fluctuate within a narrow range
最高点 peaked at 4 billion；最低点 hit a low of 0.5 billion；走平 levelled off at；小幅波动 fluctuated within a narrow range。写极值是拿内容分最省力的一步，别漏。
mistakes: the number was risen ✗ → the number rose ✓（rise / fall / decline / drop 都不及物）
the amount of people ✗ → the number of people ✓（number 可数、amount 不可数）
0.5 billion ✓ / 500 millions ✗ / 500 million ✓；20 percent 不加 s
数据用过去时（climbed），归因用现在时（has become）；"到某年为止"用过去完成 had doubled by 2008
more higher ✗ / higher ✓；as many as 中间放原级：three times as many as
checklist: 数字与图逐个核对：起止值、最高值、最低值、倍数
单位统一：billion / million 没混用，百分比写成 % 或 percent
时态：图表用过去时，归因/建议用现在时
每个 {{ }} 槽位都换成本题内容了吗
主谓一致：The number / The percentage 用单数
三段都有主题句，段落数符合题目要求
词数在 150~180（不够就多加 1 条机制句，超了就删 1 句）
没有整句照抄题干 directions
开头没有 "With the development of…" 这类空话
拼写与大小写：句首字母、专有名词、专名首字母
